incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: private-controlplane-vpc-connectivity (sev2) for customer AcmeCorp — page delivered to oncall

pagerduty: Incident created: INC-2026-4721 — escalation policy: private-infra -> oncall -> L2

maria (oncall): acked. I'm on it. pinging logs and control plane console now.

maria (oncall): acme reports intermittent 502/503 from control plane APIs since ~17:41 UTC. They say metadata sync failing, some workloads report failed attach to KMS.

ajay (sre): pulling agent heartbeats for AcmeCorp VPC (vpc-0a1b2c). last heartbeat for on-prem agent 10.20.30.5 was 17:39 then gap.

ajay (sre): running: `curl -v https://10.20.30.5:8443/health` -> connection reset. trying agent-side logs.

ajay (sre): agent log snippet:
```
2026-03-14T17:40:12Z ERROR dial tcp 10.20.30.5:443: i/o timeout
2026-03-14T17:40:12Z WARN controlplane: connection to control-plane.redwood.internal lost
2026-03-14T17:40:13Z INFO retrying connection (attempt 3)
```

olga (support): customer timeline: first report at 17:37 UTC, then spike in support calls at 17:45. Impact: management plane APIs failing for ~40% of their org (multiple clusters). They cannot create new deployments. Ticket #ACME-884 attached.

maria (oncall): checking VPC routing + NACLs. Leah, can you check if there was any recent route table change or security group modification from their side or infra? @leah (network)

leah (network): looking. No route-table changes in our control plane. I see increased RSTs from a handful of IPs in eu-west-1->customer egress path. Could be intermittent egress drop. Running `traceroute` to 10.20.30.5.

cameron (platform): quick thought — if the on-prem agent loses connectivity we should failover to the fallback control plane endpoint *temporarily* while we restore connectivity. Maria, can we flip routing for AcmeCorp to the standby endpoint? Risk: brief control-plane session invalidation.

maria (oncall): we have a route-failover playbook. I want to try a less invasive step first: attempt remote agent restart (graceful) and open additional egress to control-plane pool (443/TCP to cp-egress.redwood.net). If that doesn't work, we escalate to failover.

ajay (sre): executing remote restart via admin channel. Command: `ssh admin@10.20.30.5 sudo systemctl restart redwood-agent && journalctl -u redwood-agent -n 200 --no-pager`

ajay (sre): restart starting... output:
```
Mar 14 17:49:01 agent-host systemd[1]: Starting Redwood Onprem Agent...
Mar 14 17:49:03 agent-host redwood-agent[2345]: INFO boot ok, connecting to control plane
Mar 14 17:49:07 agent-host redwood-agent[2345]: WARN TLS handshake failed: remote error: tls: handshake failure
Mar 14 17:49:10 agent-host redwood-agent[2345]: INFO retrying with alternate egress ip
Mar 14 17:49:12 agent-host redwood-agent[2345]: INFO connected, heartbeat 17:49:12
```

ajay (sre): heartbeat restored at 17:49:12. control plane shows agent re-registered.

maria (oncall): monitoring metrics: control plane error rate dropping from 35% -> 8% over last 2m. Support, pls inform Acme that we're seeing partial restoration and we're still watching.

olga (support): messaging sent to customer: "We observed transient connectivity issues between the on-prem agent and Redwood control plane. Our team restarted the on-prem agent and connectivity is returning. We will follow up with post-incident details." Customer acknowledges and is asking for RCA ETA.

leah (network): still seeing intermittent RSTs earlier — probable upstream egress instability. I added a temporary egress route to cp-egress.redwood.net for AcmeCorp's subnet to prefer alternate path. That should reduce packet loss window.

cameron (platform): thanks. Recommend keeping the fallback route pinned for 1h and then revert if stable. Also let's mark incident as mitigated but not resolved.

pagerduty: Escalation: L2 notified (cameron (platform)).

maria (oncall): ack. I'm going to handoff monitoring to Cameron for the next hour — I'll create a short post with timeline and actions for the follow-up.

cameron (platform): taking over at 18:00 UTC. Summary for handoff:
- Impact: AcmeCorp control plane API 502/503 due to on-prem agent connectivity + upstream egress instability
- Mitigation: restarted on-prem agent (17:49 UTC) + temporary egress route to cp-egress (17:53 UTC)
- Current state: agent heartbeats OK, API error rate dropped to 5-7% and trending down, alerts clearing
- Next steps: run network packet captures during primary window, coordinate with customer network team for their egress path, schedule RCA.

maria (oncall): adding follow-up tasks in incident tracker: RCA owner Ajay, network owner Leah, customer comms Olga.

ajay (sre): quick note for RCA — attach agent logs, control-plane TLS handshake failures show remote error; need to check if there was a TLS termination/gateway restart in their edge (customer reports maintenance at 17:35 but claims it was applied to non-prod).

olga (support): customer says they did a firewall update at 17:36 that might have briefly blocked egress to cloud NAT -> looks correlated. I'll collect firewall ACL change ID and time.

cameron (platform): marking incident as mitigated. Will keep this thread open until fully resolved. I'll update when we revert temporary routing.

incident-bot: Note: incident status changed to MITIGATED by cameron (platform) at 17:58 UTC

maria (oncall): thanks everyone. Handing off to Cameron for watch and RCA. If it regresses, re-open and page L2 immediately. :thumbsup:

cameron (platform): acknowleged. I'll compile a short postmortem template and propose RCA meeting at 2026-03-15 14:00 UTC.

olga (support): customer follow-up committed. They requested a short timeline and mitigation steps.

ajay (sre): saving logs and runbook refs here: https://console.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-4721/logs (internal)

maria (oncall): closing my shift. Good catch everyone.

cameron (platform): last check at 18:14 UTC: metrics stable. moving to monitoring-only. Will update on revert plan in 30m.

leah (network): scheduled revert of temp-route at 18:40 UTC if no regression.

incident-bot: Thread auto-summary: Mitigated — restarted on-prem agent + temporary egress route to cp-egress; awaiting RCA info (owners: Ajay, Leah, Olga).
